notes: After an update, Peace now shows what changed — like this. Find it again any time in About.
Retaking setup with an AI key already saved now lets you continue past that step.
Setup now asks how Peace should look: match your phone, or pick Ledger, Graphite, Paper or Mist by seeing them.
Attach a PDF invoice or a text file to a record and Peace reads the amount from it, the same as a receipt photo.
Home-screen widgets: this month's budget, your balances, and a quick-add button.
The camera opens right inside the notes field. One press of the shutter attaches the receipt.
